content_zh:
黑暗中，两人一前一后站着，那黑影只是冷笑，走到一边椅子上坐下。
“师兄临终前可有说过什么？居然会把秘籍交给你这么个黄毛小子。”
林新心头急转，马上反应过来这人说的是什么，同时也明白了这黑影的身份。
红松门曾经失踪了的师叔，也就是他师傅的师弟，伯云子。据说是红松门曾经辉煌时期留下来的两个高手之一。
“呵呵..原来是伯云子师叔？”他感觉心头有些发颤，但强自镇定下来，“您想要秘技，给您就是，只要正大光明的登门索要，师侄难道还能不给您不成？”
他可是知道，这个伯云子可是杀人不眨眼的强横草莽，当初就是因为和师父一言不合，把老头打伤在地，扬长而去。据说在很多地方都多次做下血案，是真正的江洋大盗！
这他么才多少时间，就又遇到这种要命的事....林新终于知道为什么古代野外几乎没什么人住了...感情没点自保之力，在外面独居基本等于送死.....
吞了吞口水，越是这种情况，他越是要冷静。迅速把手里的秘技一丢，抛给伯云子。
“你倒是爽快。”伯云子似乎也没料到这家伙这么没骨气，直接就把门中最宝贵的东西给他了。
他单手接住秘籍，随手翻了翻，接着淡淡的月光，他的脸色也越发的不是很好起来。
林新在边上一动不敢动，他感觉自己胸口好像就把尖刀在正对着他一样，刀尖近在咫尺，好像他一动就会自己被割伤似的。
看着伯云子的脸色逐渐不好看起来，他心头也缓缓提起来。
伯云子面容清瘦，一身黑色道袍，长发绑成道士一样的发髻，看起来就和得道真人没什么两样，但此时随着翻看秘籍，他的面容也越发扭曲起来。
“好好好....！！不愧是师兄，临死也不忘摆我一道！好得很！！”伯云子脸色一下子变得凶厉起来。
猛然间，他一掌伸出，闪电般打向林新胸膛。一股腥臭的恶风陡然卷起，在房间内发出怪叫一样的呼啸声。
林新脑子一片发白，想要躲闪，却感觉身体僵硬，完全不听使唤。
要死了..？这就要死了？？....！
他心头一时间仿佛电击一样，连思维都好像凝固了。只能眼睁睁看着那只黑色手掌距离他胸口越来越近。
陡然间，那只手掌前面突兀的出现一大块门板，狠狠挡在林新胸前。
澎湃的掌力瞬间将黄褐色门板打成数块碎片，其中两块碎片狠狠撞在林新胸前，他只感觉胸口一闷，整个人不由自主倒飞出去。

“大师兄！！！”
月光下，他只感觉一道纤细人影飞快出现在他身前，银色的剑光拔鞘而出。
伯云子的手掌被剑光狠狠斩中，居然发出沉闷的木头声。
“咦？小归元诀？本门居然还有能修习小归元诀的弟子？”伯云子面露异色，退后数步看着挡在自己面前的女孩。
挡在林新身前的，正是本来在房内用功的安颖，此时她一身灰布贴身睡衣，手持一把明晃晃的长剑横在身前。
“想害大师兄，我和你拼了！！”安颖小脸发白，不知道是月光的问题还是其他什么原因。
伯云子怪笑一声，似乎很不以为然，看了眼倒在地上撞翻一堆杂物的林新。
“红松门，真是没落了.....”他摇摇头，身形猛地从破开的木门窜了出去，犹如黑夜里的夜枭，无声无息，几下便消失在夜色中不见。
林新胸口一阵隐痛，居然没受重伤，勉强从地上爬起来，看到伯云子转身离开，直到彻底消失在夜色里，他又等了好一会儿，仔细听着周围的动静，确定没什么声响了，他才狠狠舒了口气。
让人奇怪的是，地上的那本秘技居然没被带走，而是就这么丢在地上。
他正准备走过去把秘技捡起来，忽然发现身边的安颖有些异样。
回头一看，只见安颖小脸煞白，嘴角不知道什么时候留出猩红的血线。
“师妹你怎么样了？！”林新顿时一惊，赶紧扶住安颖，顿时感觉她身体软得厉害，也烫得厉害。
“没....没事....只是头晕得..厉害....”安颖眼睛都开始转圈圈了。嘴唇也微微泛起一丝蓝色。
安颖直接倒在地上。林新自己也感觉脑子发晕，身体发软，根本扶不住安颖，回想起刚才伯云子带起的那股腥臭恶风。

content_en:
In the darkness, the two stood one behind the other. The black figure just sneered and walked to a chair to sit down.
"Did senior brother say anything before he died? He would actually give the secret book to a young boy like you."
Lin Xin's heart raced, and he immediately realized what the man was talking about, and at the same time he also understood the identity of the black figure.
The uncle of Hongsongmen who once disappeared was his master's younger brother, Boyunzi. It is said that he is one of the two masters left behind from the glory days of Hongsong Sect.
"Haha...it turns out to be Senior Uncle Boyunzi?" He felt a little trembling in his heart, but he forced himself to calm down, "If you want a secret skill, I'll give it to you. As long as you come to ask for it in an honest and upright manner, can Senior Nephew not give it to you?"
He knows that this Boyunzi is a tyrannical and reckless man who kills without blinking an eye. It was because he had a disagreement with his master that he wounded the old man to the ground and walked away. It is said that he has committed many murders in many places and is a real gangster!
It had only been so long before he encountered such a fatal thing again... Lin Xin finally understood why almost no one lived in the ancient wilderness... He had no power to protect himself emotionally, and living alone outside was basically equivalent to death...
Swallowing his saliva, the more this situation happened, the more he had to calm down. He quickly threw the secret skill in his hand to Boyunzi.
"You're quite cheerful." Boyunzi didn't seem to expect this guy to be so spineless, so he just gave him the most precious thing in the door.
He caught the secret book with one hand and turned it over casually. Under the faint moonlight, his face became even more unhappy.
Lin Xin didn't dare to move at the edge. He felt as if a sharp knife was pointing right at him in his chest. The tip of the knife was close at hand, as if he would be cut if he moved.
Seeing Boyunzi's face gradually turning ugly, his heart slowly rose.
Boyunzi has a thin face, a black Taoist robe, and long hair tied into a bun like a Taoist priest. He looks just like the Taoist master, but as he reads the secret book, his face becomes more and more distorted.
"Okay, okay...!! As expected of a senior brother, he will not forget to show his support to me even before he dies! Very good!!" Boyunzi's face suddenly became fierce.
Suddenly, he stretched out his palm and struck Lin Xin's chest like lightning. A foul smelling wind suddenly blew up, making a strange whistling sound in the room.
Lin Xin's mind turned white and he wanted to dodge, but his body felt stiff and completely disobedient.
Dying...? Are you going to die? ? ....!
His heart felt like an electric shock for a moment, and even his thoughts seemed to freeze. He could only watch the black palm getting closer and closer to his chest.
Suddenly, a large door panel suddenly appeared in front of the palm, blocking Lin Xin's chest.
The surging palm force instantly shattered the tawny door panel into several pieces, two of which hit Lin Xin's chest hard. He felt a tightness in his chest and his whole body flew out involuntarily.
"Big Brother!!!"
Under the moonlight, he felt a slender figure quickly appear in front of him, and a silver sword was drawn out of its sheath.
Boyunzi's palm was struck hard by the sword light, and it made a dull wooden sound.
"Huh? Xiao Guiyuan Jue? There are actually disciples in our sect who can practice Xiao Guiyuan Jue?" Boyunzi looked strange, stepped back and looked at the girl standing in front of him.
The person standing in front of Lin Xin was An Ying, who had been studying in the room. She was wearing gray cloth pajamas and holding a bright long sword in front of her.
"If you want to harm senior brother, I will fight with you!!" An Ying's face turned pale. She didn't know if it was the moonlight's problem or some other reason.
Boyunzi laughed strangely, seemingly disapproving, and glanced at Lin Xin who fell to the ground and knocked over a pile of debris.
"The red pine door is really in decline..." He shook his head and rushed out of the broken wooden door, as if in the dark night.The night owl disappeared silently into the night.
Lin Xin felt a dull pain in his chest, but he was not seriously injured. He reluctantly got up from the ground. When he saw Boyunzi turning and leaving, until he completely disappeared into the night, he waited for a while and listened carefully to the movement around him. After making sure that there was no sound, he breathed a sigh of relief.
What is strange is that the secret book on the ground was not taken away, but was just thrown on the ground.
He was about to walk over and pick up the secret skill when he suddenly noticed something strange about An Ying next to him.
Looking back, I saw that An Ying's face was pale, and a scarlet blood line appeared at the corner of her mouth.
"Junior sister, how are you?!" Lin Xin was shocked and quickly supported An Ying. She suddenly felt that her body was very soft and very hot.
"No...it's okay...it's just that I feel dizzy..." An Ying's eyes started to spin in circles. The lips also had a slight hint of blue.
An Ying fell directly to the ground. Lin Xin himself felt dizzy and weak, unable to hold An Ying up. He recalled the smelly and evil wind brought by Boyunzi just now.
